category_title: Students with low online continuity and infrequent LMS participation
minimal_context: The student is participating in a face-to-face communicative practice activity in the language classroom where they must discuss their weekend plans.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's practice our speaking. Please tell me about your plans for the weekend in the target language, and then we can have a discussion about it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will go to the park. I will watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you tell me more about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The movie is good. I like movies.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to ask me a question or add more details so we can have a conversation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know how to say more. I just share the same plans as my partner. That is all.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's practice our speaking. Please tell me about your plans for the weekend in the target language, and then we can have a discussion about it.

STUDENT: I will go to the park. I will watch a movie.

TUTOR: Can you tell me more about that?

STUDENT: The movie is good. I like movies.

TUTOR: Try to ask me a question or add more details so we can have a conversation.

STUDENT: I don't know how to say more. I just share the same plans as my partner. That is all.

task.learning_goal: Facilitating language acquisition as opposed to conveying information

context.environment: During the F2F components of the blended course

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Because they were lower-level language students with limited linguistic resources
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Use of the target language for display purposes rather than to generate rich discussions

behavior_patterns.condition: During face-to-face sessions of a blended course
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Use of the target language for display purposes
